title: koa-router is deprecated
summary: npm marks koa-router as deprecated: "Please use @koa/router instead, starting from v9!"

constraints: Preserve route paths, parameter names, middleware order, allowed methods, and error handling.

steps.title: Replace koa-router
steps.instructions: Move the dependency and imports from koa-router to @koa/router and keep the current constructor and middleware usage.

steps.title: Verify routing behavior
steps.instructions: Exercise every route, parameter pattern, and allowed method to confirm dispatch and error handling are unchanged.

verification.purpose: Run the routing and repository tests when defined.
